mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مُو?
mcq.explanation: مُو is read muu.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لِ?
mcq.explanation: لِ is read li.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ (al-jawwu haarr) means: The weather is hot.

mcq.q: Which is the correct spelling of Thursday?
mcq.explanation: Thursday begins with khaa (خ), which has one dot above.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clean"?
mcq.explanation: نَظِيفٌ (nadhiif) means clean.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is a party."
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ حَفْلَةٌ (haadhihi hafla) means: This is a party.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي هَدِيَّةٌ (ʿindii hadiyya) means: I have a gift.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "peace be upon you"?
mcq.explanation: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ مُفِيدٌ (al-maa'u mufiid) means: Water is useful (good for you).

mcq.q: What does it mean if a paragraph is coherent?
options: Its sentences fit together and make sense
mcq.explanation: A coherent paragraph has related sentences in a sensible order.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ت?
mcq.explanation: The letter ت is called taa.

mcq.q: What is a stanza?
options: A group of lines in a poem
mcq.explanation: A stanza is like a paragraph in a poem.

mcq.q: What does the word يَا (yaa) do in مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ?
options: It calls a person, like 'O' or 'hey'
mcq.explanation: yaa is used to call someone by name.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ (al-jawwu mumtir) means: The weather is rainy.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word تَحْتَ (taHta) mean?
mcq.explanation: تَحْتَ (taHta) means under.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ (haadhihi shams) means: This is the sun.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "leg"?
mcq.explanation: رِجْلٌ (rijl) means leg.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ظ?
mcq.explanation: The letter ظ is called DHaa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا (ahlan wa sahlan) means welcome.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word يَدٌ (yad) mean?
mcq.explanation: يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ (raʾsii kabiir) means: My head is big.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter س?
mcq.explanation: The letter س is called siin.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my father."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لَحْمٌ (lahm) mean?
mcq.explanation: لَحْمٌ (lahm) means meat.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cold"?
mcq.explanation: بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'On the table there is a cake'?
mcq.explanation: ʿalaa means on, taawila is table and kaʿka is cake.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ث?
mcq.explanation: The letter ث is called thaa.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word رَقَبَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: رَقَبَةٌ is read raqaba and means neck.

mcq.q: What is the special sign hamza (ء)?
options: A short stop in the throat
mcq.explanation: The hamza is a short pause made in the throat, like the stop in 'uh-oh'.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word تُفَّاحٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: تُفَّاحٌ is read tuffaah and means apples.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بِيئَةٌ is read bii'a and means environment.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence مَا اسْمُكِ؟ mean?
options: What is your name? (to a girl)
mcq.explanation: مَا اسْمُكِ؟ (maa ismuki?) means: What is your name? (to a girl)

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "sky"?
mcq.explanation: سَمَاءٌ (samaa') means sky.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ (al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka) means: The friends eat the cake.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَرْحَبًا is read marhaban and means hello.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word مَطَرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: مَطَرٌ is read matar and means rain.

mcq.q: How many letters are in the Arabic alphabet?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic alphabet has 28 letters.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "family"?
mcq.explanation: أُسْرَةٌ (usra) means family.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَيْتٌ (bayt) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "festival"?
mcq.explanation: عِيدٌ (ʿiid) means festival.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

mcq.q: What is the sound dh in udhun like in English?
mcq.explanation: The letter dh is like the th in 'this'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ح?
mcq.explanation: The letter ح is called Haa.

mcq.q: What does the mark sukuun (a small circle) show?
options: The letter is silent and not written
mcq.explanation: A sukuun shows that the consonant is read without a vowel.

mcq.q: What does ilmis anfaka tell you to do?
mcq.explanation: ilmis means touch and anfaka means your nose.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have two eyes."
mcq.explanation: لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word دَوْرِي read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرِي is read dawrii and means my turn.

mcq.q: What sits on the baseline in Arabic writing?
mcq.explanation: Most letters rest on the baseline. Alif stands tall above it.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable قَا?
mcq.explanation: قَا is read qaa.

mcq.q: Which word means 'I drink'?
mcq.explanation: ashrabu means I drink. aakulu means I eat and uhibbu means I like.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) mean?
mcq.explanation: اُخْرُجْ (ukhruj) means go out.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كَتِفٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كَتِفٌ is read katif and means shoulder.

mcq.q: Which day is al-khamiis?
mcq.explanation: al-khamiis is Thursday, the fifth day, from the word for five.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ز make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ز makes the sound z as in zebra.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable لُ?
mcq.explanation: لُ is read lu.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word شَمْسٌ (shams) mean?
mcq.explanation: شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word جَبَلٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: جَبَلٌ is read jabal and means mountain.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The house is big."
mcq.explanation: الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baytu kabiir) means: The house is big.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ن make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ن makes the sound n as in net.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "delicious"?
mcq.explanation: لَذِيذٌ (ladhiidh) means delicious.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ mean?
options: The lamp is above the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The book is on the table.
The pen is in the bag.
mcq.explanation: الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ (al-qittatu taHta s-sariir) means: The cat is under the bed.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تُ?
mcq.explanation: تُ is read tu.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُسْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُسْرَةٌ is read usra and means family.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "book"?
mcq.explanation: كِتَابٌ (kitaab) means book.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَبِي يَعْمَلُ mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: أَبِي يَعْمَلُ (abii yaʿmalu) means: My father works.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Do not play with the knife."
mcq.explanation: لَا تَلْعَبْ بِالسِّكِّينِ (laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin) means: Do not play with the knife.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my hand."
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

mcq.q: The nuclear family is made of
mcq.explanation: The nuclear family is the smallest family group: parents and their children.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بَطْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بَطْنٌ is read batn and means stomach.

mcq.q: Which of these is a position word?
mcq.explanation: ʿinda means at. The other words are things.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "clock"?
mcq.explanation: سَاعَةٌ (saaʿa) means clock.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "tooth"?
mcq.explanation: سِنٌّ (sinn) means tooth.

mcq.q: What can help a nervous speaker?
mcq.explanation: Practice makes a speaker calm and confident.

mcq.q: What happens to the voice at the end of a statement?
mcq.explanation: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَنْفٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَنْفٌ is read anf and means nose.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ت make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ت makes the sound t as in tap.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رَأْسٌ (raʾs) mean?
mcq.explanation: رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

mcq.q: Which question word means 'who'?
mcq.explanation: man means who. ayna means where, kam means how many and limaadhaa means why.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I visit my grandmother on Friday'?
mcq.explanation: azuuru means I visit and jaddatii means my grandmother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "cake"?
mcq.explanation: كَعْكَةٌ (kaʿka) means cake.

mcq.q: Which pair of words are two family members from the father's side and the mother's side?
mcq.explanation: ʿamm is the father's brother and khaal is the mother's brother.

mcq.q: Which polite word means 'excuse me' when you want to speak?
mcq.explanation: ʿafwan is used to say 'excuse me' or 'pardon' before speaking.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "school"?
mcq.explanation: مَدْرَسَةٌ (madrasa) means school.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word سَمَاءٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: سَمَاءٌ is read samaa' and means sky.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بُ?
mcq.explanation: بُ is read bu.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable تَ?
mcq.explanation: تَ is read ta.

mcq.q: What does the word ghadan mean?
mcq.explanation: ghadan means tomorrow. amsi means yesterday.

mcq.q: Which is a rule of good turn taking?
options: Speak at the same time as others
Wait until the speaker has finished
mcq.explanation: Good speakers wait for their turn and use polite words if they must interrupt.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لَا (laa) mean?
mcq.explanation: لَا (laa) means no.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ mean?
options: I read a book on Sunday.
The chair is at the door.
The key is in the cupboard.
Do not play with the knife.
mcq.explanation: الْمِفْتَاحُ فِي الْخِزَانَةِ (al-miftaahu fii l-khizaana) means: The key is in the cupboard.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I like bananas."
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْمَوْزَ (uhibbu l-mawza) means: I like bananas.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "vegetables"?
mcq.explanation: خُضَارٌ (khudaar) means vegetables.

mcq.q: Which sentence says 'I hear with my ear'?
mcq.explanation: asmaʿu means I hear and udhun means ear.

mcq.q: What does the ending -aani show in yadaani?
mcq.explanation: The dual ending -aani means two, so yadaani is two hands.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "congratulations"?
mcq.explanation: مَبْرُوكٌ (mabruuk) means congratulations.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word لِسَانٌ (lisaan) mean?
mcq.explanation: لِسَانٌ (lisaan) means tongue.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable ثَا?
mcq.explanation: ثَا is read thaa.
